user.description: Unix user the worker processes run as.

group.description: Unix group the worker processes run as.

listen.description: Unix socket path or ip:port the pool accepts FastCGI requests on.

listen_owner.description: Owner of the Unix socket (empty: not set).

listen_group.description: Group of the Unix socket (empty: not set).

listen_mode.description: Mode of the Unix socket, e.g. 0660 (empty: not set).

listen_acl_users.description: Users granted socket access via POSIX ACLs, comma-separated.

listen_allowed_clients.description: Client addresses allowed on a TCP listen address (empty: any).

pm_max_children.description: Maximum number of children alive at the same time.

pm_max_requests.description: Requests a child serves before it is respawned (0: never).

pm_status_path.description: URI of the FPM status page (empty: disabled).

request_slowlog_timeout.description: Requests slower than this are logged to slowlog, e.g. 5s (written only together with slowlog — php-fpm refuses it alone).
